scope: R23 analytics, compliance close, compliance export, and distinct billing month-close metadata audit with immutable snapshots, scoped references, transition constraints, deterministic indexes, migration identity, and live orphan checks.

constraints.name: BillingMonthClose_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ComplianceClose_tenant_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ComplianceExportJob_close_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "closeId") REFERENCES "ComplianceClose"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ComplianceExportJob_content
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'ready'::text) AND ("resultCipher" IS NOT NULL) AND ("resultHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("completedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("byteLength" > 0)) OR ((status <> 'ready'::text) AND ("resultCipher" IS NULL) AND ("resultHash" IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ComplianceExportJob_lease
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'processing'::text) AND ("leaseOwner" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leaseUntil" IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'processing'::text) AND ("leaseOwner" IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ComplianceExportJob_requester_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "memberId", "requesterId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id, "userId") ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ComplianceExportJob_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'processing'::text, 'ready'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text, 'deleted'::text])) AND (format = ANY (ARRAY['pdf'::text, 'csv'::text])) AND (version > 0) AND (attempts >= 0) AND (("byteLength" >= 0) AND ("byteLength" <= 16777216)) AND (("pageCount" >= 0) AND ("pageCount" <= 250))))

indexes.name: BillingMonthClose_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "BillingMonthClose_key" ON public."BillingMonthClose" USING btree ("tenantId", month, currency)

indexes.name: BillingMonthClose_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "BillingMonthClose_pkey" ON public."BillingMonthClose" USING btree (id)

indexes.name: ComplianceClose_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ComplianceClose_pkey" ON public."ComplianceClose" USING btree (id)

indexes.name: ComplianceClose_tenantId_createdAt_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX "ComplianceClose_tenantId_createdAt_idx" ON public."ComplianceClose" USING btree ("tenantId", "createdAt")

indexes.name: ComplianceClose_tenantId_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ComplianceClose_tenantId_id_key" ON public."ComplianceClose" USING btree ("tenantId", id)

indexes.name: ComplianceClose_tenantId_serviceKey_month_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ComplianceClose_tenantId_serviceKey_month_key" ON public."ComplianceClose" USING btree ("tenantId", "serviceKey", month)

indexes.name: ComplianceExportJob_expiresAt_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX "ComplianceExportJob_expiresAt_idx" ON public."ComplianceExportJob" USING btree ("expiresAt")

indexes.name: ComplianceExportJob_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ComplianceExportJob_pkey" ON public."ComplianceExportJob" USING btree (id)

indexes.name: ComplianceExportJob_status_leaseUntil_createdAt_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX "ComplianceExportJob_status_leaseUntil_createdAt_idx" ON public."ComplianceExportJob" USING btree (status, "leaseUntil", "createdAt")

indexes.name: ComplianceExportJob_tenantId_memberId_closeId_createdAt_id_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX "ComplianceExportJob_tenantId_memberId_closeId_createdAt_id_idx" ON public."ComplianceExportJob" USING btree ("tenantId", "memberId", "closeId", "createdAt", id)

indexes.name: ComplianceExportJob_tenantId_memberId_requestKeyHash_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ComplianceExportJob_tenantId_memberId_requestKeyHash_key" ON public."ComplianceExportJob" USING btree ("tenantId", "memberId", "requestKeyHash")

triggers.name: BillingMonthClose_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "BillingMonthClose_guard" BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."BillingMonthClose" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION check_month_close()

triggers.name: compliance_close_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER compliance_close_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."ComplianceClose" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_compliance_close()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_compliance_close()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'compliance closes are immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END; $function$

triggers.name: compliance_export_transition
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER compliance_export_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON public."ComplianceExportJob" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_compliance_export()
